_comment: Documents the ladder scripts/bench/suites/classroom-concurrency.mjs runs; the scorer's own defaults are the source of truth for anything omitted here. Real Sage prompt text and student data are never used — the synthetic system prompt/user message come from scripts/sage-load-test.mjs's own buildSyntheticSystemPrompt/syntheticUserMessage, sized to match a real Sage prompt's character count.
note: model/url null means: fall back to OLLAMA_MODEL/OLLAMA_URL env vars, then "gemma4:latest"/http://localhost:11434 — same defaults scripts/sage-load-test.mjs's own CLI uses.
